mapper.update: UPDATE guardian_students SET status='UNLINKED',unlinked_at=NOW(),unlinked_by=#{by} WHERE guardian_id=#{guardianId} AND student_id=#{studentId} AND status='ACTIVE'

mapper.sql: sp.student_id AS studentId,sp.name,sp.age,c.name AS centerName,DATE_FORMAT(gs.linked_at,'%Y-%m-%d') AS linkedOn,gs.status AS linkStatus
mapper.select: SELECT FROM guardian_students gs JOIN student_profiles sp ON sp.student_id=gs.student_id JOIN centers c ON c.center_id=sp.center_id WHERE gs.guardian_id=#{guardianId} AND gs.student_id=#{studentId} AND gs.status='ACTIVE'

SELECT FROM guardian_students gs JOIN student_profiles sp ON sp.student_id=gs.student_id JOIN centers c ON c.center_id=sp.center_id WHERE gs.guardian_id=#{guardianId} AND gs.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY gs.linked_at,sp.student_id

SELECT u.user_id AS guardianId,u.name,DATE_FORMAT(gs.linked_at,'%Y-%m-%d') AS linkedOn FROM guardian_students gs JOIN users u ON u.user_id=gs.guardian_id WHERE gs.student_id=#{studentId} AND gs.status='ACTIVE' AND u.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY gs.linked_at

SELECT gs.guardian_id AS guardianId,u.name AS guardianName,gs.status, DATE_FORMAT(gs.linked_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS linkedAt,DATE_FORMAT(gs.unlinked_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS unlinkedAt,gs.unlinked_by AS unlinkedBy FROM guardian_students gs JOIN users u ON u.user_id=gs.guardian_id WHERE gs.student_id=#{studentId} AND (gs.linked_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL #{days} DAY) OR gs.unlinked_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL #{days} DAY))

SELECT uc.consent_type AS type,uc.agreed,uc.policy_version AS policyVersion, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(uc.withdrawn_at,uc.agreed_at),'%Y-%m-%d') AS changedOn FROM student_profiles sp JOIN user_consents uc ON uc.user_id=sp.user_id WHERE sp.student_id=#{studentId} ORDER BY uc.consent_type
